meta.title: Bandizip archives
meta.description: Without a matching tool in reach, an agent falls back to unpacking file by file — slow, and the directory structure tends to be lost. This plugin puts the installed Bandizip console tool (bz.exe) in the tool surface so the agent can manage archives: create packs files or folders, optionally filtered by glob or appended to an existing archive; extract unpacks into a chosen folder with archive-internal masks, a trial run, and path-traversal protection; list shows entries with filtering and paging; test checks integrity and passwords; preview reports per-directory, per-extension, and size statistics plus the largest entries without extracting; diff compares two archives by entry name and size for additions, removals, and changes; browse walks the archive tree one folder level at a time; convert repacks into another format, level, or password and verifies the result. Writing supports zip, zipx, 7z, tar, tgz, gz, xz, iso, lzh, and self-extracting exe, and reading also covers rar and other formats; relative paths resolve against the session working directory and nothing opens a window or waits for a prompt. Compression level, recursion, overwrite policy, mode, encoding, destination, and timeout are all decided per call rather than fixed in the plugin. Note: passwords are passed to bz.exe as command-line switches, so other processes on this PC can see them; extraction defaults to a folder beside the archive; create never replaces an existing archive unless overwriting is enabled and explicitly requested. Turning the plugin off removes the tool.
